IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Cleveland, Eide, Billig, and Chase

Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying when to display vehicle headlights.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vehicle headlights; and amending RCW 46.37.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.37.020 and 1977 ex.s. c 355 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every vehicle upon a highway within this state at any time from ahalf hour after sunset to a half hour before sunrise and at any othertime when, due to insufficient light or unfavorable atmosphericconditions, persons and vehicles on the highway are not clearlydiscernible at a distance of one thousand five hundred feet ahead shalldisplay lighted headlights, other lights, and illuminating devices ashereinafter respectively required for different classes of vehicles,subject to exceptions with respect to parked vehicles, and such stoplights, turn signals, and other signaling devices shall be lighted asprescribed for the use of such devices.
